// Stands in for `openapi-typescript`: whatever `pnpm run gen:api` runs, the
// guard's property is that running it changes a committed file under
// src/lib/api-types/. The generator's identity is not part of that property.
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const generated = `// Generated by gen:api. DO NOT EDIT.
export interface paths {
  "/documents": unknown;
  "/documents/{id}": unknown;
  "/documents/{id}/archive": unknown;
}
`;

mkdirSync("src/lib/api-types", { recursive: true });
writeFileSync("src/lib/api-types/index.d.ts", generated);
